title: Coverage Bulletin: Roadside Trip Interruption Transportation Set against Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Rideshare Reimbursement
content:
**Coverage position.** Alternate transportation already paid under the trip interruption benefit of Cardinal Roadside Assistance is set against the rideshare reimbursement under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement. The amount set against depends on the service date of the trip interruption payments in the alternate transportation expense category, compared with the report date on the Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage claim.

| Alternate transportation paid by roadside trip interruption | Amount set against the rideshare reimbursement |
|---|---|
| Paid with a service date on the claim's report date | The full amount paid for alternate transportation with that service date |
| Paid only for other service dates | 0.5 (half) of what was paid, rounded to the cent |
| None paid | Nothing |

The amount set against is taken off the covered rideshare days multiplied by the daily rideshare amount. What remains is held to what the per-loss maximum still allows, is never below zero, and is rounded to the cent.

Only alternate transportation counts. Lodging and meals paid under trip interruption are not set against the rideshare reimbursement.

## Illustrations (hypothetical, claim report date September 9; covered rideshare days multiplied by the daily amount comes to $175.00)

1. Roadside paid $60.00 of alternate transportation with service date September 9, and $40.00 with service date September 10. The amount set against is $60.00, the amount on the report date. The reimbursement before the per-loss limit is $175.00 less $60.00, which is $115.00.
2. Roadside paid $40.00 on September 10 and $35.30 on September 11, and nothing on September 9. The amount set against is half of $75.30, which is $37.65. The reimbursement before the per-loss limit is $137.35.
3. Roadside paid no alternate transportation. Nothing is set against, and the reimbursement before the per-loss limit is $175.00.
